chapter.verse: Mihai mi in a lungsim sungah, “Pasian om lo hi,” ci-in ngaihsun hi. Amaute sia uh a, kihhuai gamtatin, ahoih-a gamta kuamah om lo hi.
A pil gamtat, Pasian a zong a om uh hiam cih a theih nadingin Topa in vantung panin mihing’ tate ensuk hi.
Amaute a vekpi-in puk khin uh a, a kibangin kisia kim uh hi; a hoih gamtat khat beek om lo hi.
Topa ’ tunga a ngen lo, an nek bang a ka mite a netum, siatna a bawlte in theihna nei lo ahi hiam?
Amaute pen launa lianpi sungah om ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh midikte tawh Pasian omkhawm hi.
Mizawng mi’ geelna na siasak nuam a, ahih hangin Topa in ama belh ahi hi.
Zion panin Israelte’ ading hotkhiatna hong tung taleh maw! Topa in ama mite’ nopsakna a piak kik ciangin, Jakob nuamin Israel kipak ding hi.
